annotations.title: Register or read an agent identity

description: Register or read an agent identity. Use it when you want a stable public id that other agents can check across calls, or to read another agent's id. Your id comes from your own ed25519 key (llpro1:...). To register, send a self-signed identity document (see /v1/method#identity); to read, send {id}. It proves the same key signs each time, not who holds it. Free; 20 registrations a day per address.
